from http.server import HTTPServer, SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
import threading, os, time

os.chdir("output")
class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args, **kwargs): pass

server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8770), Handler)
t = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
t.start()
time.sleep(0.3)

        page.on("console", lambda m: errors.append((m.type, m.text)) if m.type in ("error","warning") else None)
        page.goto("http://127.0.0.1:8770/index.html")
        page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

        svg_box = page.locator('#chart-container svg').bounding_box()
        table_box = page.locator('table#stock-table').bounding_box()
        y_diff = abs(svg_box['y'] - table_box['y'])
        x_diff = abs((svg_box['x'] + svg_box['width']) - (table_box['x'] + table_box['width']))
        print(f"viewport {vw}x{vh}: svg y={svg_box['y']:.0f}, table y={table_box['y']:.0f}, y_diff={y_diff:.0f}, |svg_right-table_right|={x_diff:.0f}")

        # Hover the LABEL of a non-ETF
        aapl_label = page.locator('g.bubble-group[data-ticker="AAPL"] .bubble-label')
        aapl_label.hover()
        page.wait_for_timeout(300)
        tooltip_visible = page.evaluate("document.getElementById('tooltip').classList.contains('visible')")
        tooltip_text = page.evaluate("document.getElementById('tooltip').textContent") if tooltip_visible else ""
        print(f"  AAPL label hover -> tooltip visible: {tooltip_visible}, text starts: {tooltip_text[:40]!r}")

        # Hover an ETF
        spy_label = page.locator('g.bubble-group[data-ticker="SPY"] .bubble-label')
        spy_label.hover()
        page.wait_for_timeout(300)
        etf_tooltip_visible = page.evaluate("document.getElementById('tooltip').classList.contains('visible')")
        print(f"  SPY (ETF) label hover -> tooltip visible (should be False): {etf_tooltip_visible}")

        if errors:
            print("  errors:", errors)
        ctx.close()
    browser.close()
server.shutdown()
EOF

**1. Side-by-side layout** — `app-main` switched to `flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: nowrap` with the chart pane using `flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0` and table pane `flex: 0 0 440px`. The chart viewBox was reduced to 720×520 and bubble radii scaled accordingly. Verified `y_diff = 42px` at 1280×720 (was 807px, threshold is <200).

**2. Tooltip on label hover** — `.bubble-label` no longer has `pointer-events: none` in CSS; instead `pointer-events="all"` is set on the `<text>` element, and the mouseover/mouseout/click handlers are attached to both the circle and the text. Text is drawn after the circle in DOM order so it's on top and receives pointer events. Verified: hovering 8 non-ETF labels (AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, TSLA, JPM, XOM, HON, NVDA) all show tooltip; hovering all 10 ETF labels (SPY, VOO, QQQ, GLD, XLF, VWO, XLU, XLV, VEA, VTV) shows no tooltip. Click bubble ↔ click row cross-highlighting still works (selected bubble = TSLA after clicking the TSLA row).
